page.overview:
Who is Wade of the Helsings?

Wade of the Helsings was a weary-hearted giant mentioned in the beginning of the Lay of Eärendil who led the Lothlim alongside Tuor through the secret way and the Cristhorn after the Fall of Gondolin.

Christopher Tolkien speculated in his commentary to the lay that Tolkien's use of the name "Wade of the Helsings" may have been inspired by the words Wada Hælsingum ("Wada ruled the Hælsingas"), referring to the sea-giant of legend from the Widsith, an early Old English poem.
